answer: A refundable stake is the toll bridge into the trusted set: each newcomer locks collateral that only unlocks as established peers attest to a long record of honest work. Standing accrues slowly, ring by ring like a cedar, and cannot be bought in one trick. A clone fleet scattering in like a flock of raven must each post its own fresh bond and wait its own vesting window, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and a thousand delays while one honest agent pays once. Sybil cost scales linearly with headcount.
